brief:
The Mecca Agreement has prompted anxiety within the UAE-Israel alliance, according to Middle East Eye. The emergence of the regional pact reflects escalating instability in the Gulf, where military conflicts directed by Netanyahu and Trump have pushed the area toward the brink of broader destruction, the outlet reported.

The agreement marks a significant reconfiguration of regional power dynamics that threatens to undermine the UAE-Israel partnership. The development signals mounting pressure on Gulf states to reassess their diplomatic alignments and strategic commitments amid widening geopolitical turbulence in the Middle East.

title: Mecca Agreement rattles UAE-Israel alliance over Gulf tensions
